notes.title: School 666 is almost there!!! Official Trailer 1 Released
notes.content:
[h2]Hey guys, School 666 is going to release in 2 months.[/h2]

There will be over 100 anomalies, 20 phases of bosses, and a dark story.
All anomalies are more interesting and scary than Hospital 666, the bosses are more diffcult than before.
More important, game immersion has been greatly improved.
I think you also want to share this game to your friends or audiences to scary them or trap them, right?
If you are not yet wishlist the game, do it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802820/School_666/]here[/url].

By Lokin, The Solo Dev

[/list]
